mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, we are seeing fair conditions at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 70 degrees.

Please note that City of Verona buildings will be closed on November 26 and 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday. Additionally, the City is moving forward with expansion plans for the Public Works and Utilities facility to better serve our growing population.
There is plenty to do this weekend, including live music at Bailey's Run today, Paddy Mac's music series today, and more tunes at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.
In a notable incident from November 9, a driver was arrested for an O W I, third offence, after being observed driving in an unsafe manner on USH 18/151.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:30 PM tonight.
